headline: Israeli military attacks and displaces Palestinians in Gaza while expanding its yellow line deeper
label: NEWS
caption:
Winter floods and aid blockades are worsening the crisis for displaced families in Gaza 🌧️

According to Middle East Eye and Mondoweiss, Israeli attacks continue across the Gaza Strip while displacement expands daily.

An aid worker for the UN agency for Palestinian refugees, Unrwa, was k!lled early on Monday morning in the Jabalia refugee camp during the attacks.

At the same time, Israel is still displacing Palestinians in Gaza by expanding its yellow line deeper into the strip every day.

This ongoing military activity comes as the aid blockade and winter floods further deepen the suffering of civilians.

How can the international community better protect aid workers and civilians in active conflict zones 👇
